_comment: tools/build_rp.py 가 생성. 손으로 고치지 말 것.
frame: entity-local frame of each item_display (spawned at the oni player's feet, rotated by its yaw). +Y up, +Z = forward (the oni faces +Z; yaw 0 = south), +X = the oni's LEFT (yaw 0: east), -X = the oni's right. Joint offsets are measured from the feet.
joint_contract: In every part model the joint/pivot is model pixel (8,8,8). With item_display:"none" (the default) and an identity transformation, model pixel (px,py,pz) appears at entity-local ((8-px)/16, (py-8)/16, (8-pz)/16) blocks from the display entity. So summon/teleport every part to the oni's feet with yaw = player yaw, pitch 0, and set transformation.translation = joint * s, scale = [s,s,s] (s = overall size, 1.0 normal), left_rotation = swing quaternion, right_rotation = identity. left_rotation then pivots the part about its joint.
swing: Rotation about the entity-local +X axis (right-hand rule; quaternion [sin(a/2),0,0,cos(a/2)] or {angle:a_rad,axis:[1f,0f,0f]}). Positive angle moves the lower end of a hanging limb BACKWARD (-Z), tips the torso/head FORWARD (head looks down, same sign as player pitch). Forward swing of an arm/leg = NEGATIVE angle. Rest pose (angle 0) = limbs straight down, torso/head upright, face toward +Z. If the torso is rotated, move child joints (arms, head) with it: child_translation = s * (torso_joint + R_torso * (child_joint - torso_joint)) and child_rotation = R_torso * R_child (all rotations about X: child angle = torso angle + own angle).

camera.note: At scale 1 both eye heights (feet +1.62 standing, +1.27 sneaking) are inside the convex head, whose inner faces are omitted and outer faces are back-face culled from inside, so the oni player never sees the head from inside, at any look direction (checked by tools/rp_preview.py). This also holds for any head pitch within max_swing_deg. The oni player does see its own torso/arms/feet when looking down (like a body). If the whole model is scaled by s, also set the player's minecraft:scale attribute to s so the eye stays inside (head spans feet + s*1.21875 .. s*2.375).

head.desc: 머리 (목 관절에서 위로). 각도 + = 고개 숙임

torso.desc: 몸통 (엉덩이 관절에서 위로). 각도 + = 앞으로 숙임

walk_cycle_hint.phase: arm_l swings with leg_r, arm_r with leg_l (arm and leg on the same side opposite)
walk_cycle_hint.head: angle = clamp(player pitch, -30, 30)
walk_cycle_hint.attack: arm_r: raise to -90 (straight forward) then swing back to about +20 within 4-6 ticks. Beyond -90 the hand crosses the face/jaw (the head is wider than the shoulders).

notes: Pack formats: misode/mcmeta summary/versions/data.json resource_pack_version(.minor): 1.21.5=55, 1.21.6=63, 1.21.7/8=64, 1.21.9/10=69, 1.21.11=75, 26.1-26.1.2=84, 26.2=88, 26.3=97.1 (also 26.3 client version.json pack_version resource_major=97, resource_minor=1).

pack.mcmeta: 1.21.9+ parser = PackFormat$IntermediaryFormat.validate(lastPreMinor=64 for CLIENT_RESOURCES (PackFormat.lastPreMinorVersion: bipush 64), requireFormat=true, overlay=false). min_format present -> validateNewFormat: min.major(55) <= 64 so supported_formats is required with min == min_format.major and max == max_format.major (or == 64), and pack_format must lie in [55, 97]. min_format int -> [55, 0] (BOTTOM_CODEC), max_format int -> [97, 2147483647] (TOP_CODEC) so 97.1 is accepted. Older parsers (1.21.5-1.21.8) read pack_format + supported_formats [55, 97] and ignore min/max_format. Same logic and constants in 1.21.11 (azz$a.validate, azz.a(PackType) bipush 64/81) and 26.3.

item_display 180 deg: DisplayRenderer$ItemDisplayRenderer.submitInner (26.3) = `aload_2; getstatic Axis.YP; ldc 3.1415927f; invokevirtual PoseStack.rotate(Axis,F)` then ItemStackRenderState.submit. 1.21.11 (hwe$b.a(ied,fzm,hpo,int,float)): `getstatic a.d (Axis.YP); ldc 3.1415927f; invokeinterface a.rotation(F); invokevirtual fzm.a(Quaternionfc) (PoseStack.mulPose)`. 1.21.5 (gxj$b.renderInner): identical `getstatic a.d; ldc 3.1415927f; a.rotation; fld.a(Quaternionfc)`.

Order in DisplayRenderer.submit/render: poseStack.rotate(calculateOrientation) [FIXED billboard: Quaternionf.rotationYXZ(-0.017453292f*yRot, 0.017453292f*xRot, 0)] -> poseStack.mulPose(transformation) -> submitInner (Y 180) -> item layer transform. So the transformation acts in entity-local space where +Z = the entity's facing direction (yaw 0 = south, yaw 90 = west) and +X = its left.

ItemDisplayContext NONE: ItemTransforms.getTransform(context) is a tableswitch over the named contexts (9 in 26.3/1.21.11, 8 in 1.21.5); NONE falls to `default: getstatic ItemTransform.NO_TRANSFORM`. ItemTransform.apply(boolean, PoseStack$Pose): `if (this == NO_TRANSFORM) { pose.translate(-0.5f,-0.5f,-0.5f); return; }` (otherwise translate/rotate/scale then the same -0.5 translate). Called from ItemStackRenderState$LayerRenderState.applyTransform (26.3) / render (1.21.x). No default display transform applies for 'none' (model 'display' blocks have no 'none' entry).

FaceBakery.bakeVertex: position = FaceInfo$VertexInfo.select(from,to) / 16.0f (after element rotation about origin*0.0625), so model pixel p -> p/16 - 0.5 -> RotY(pi) -> (-(p.x/16-0.5), p.y/16-0.5, -(p.z/16-0.5)). Hence the face texture is on the model's north (-Z) face, which ends up facing entity +Z, and the oni's left (+X) is model -X (west).

Element rotation: 26.3 CuboidRotation$SingleAxisRotation.transformation = Matrix4f.rotation(angle*0.017453292f, axis.getPositive().getUnitVec3f()); 1.21.5 FaceBakery.applyElementRotation = Quaternionf.rotationAxis(angle*0.017453292f, +axis). 1.21.5 BlockElement$Deserializer.getAngle only accepts 0/±22.5/±45, so the jaw wedges use ±22.5 about z (rescale false). A local rotation by a about entity +Z is model angle -a.
26.3 CuboidItemModelWrapper$Unbaked has an optional 'transformation' field (identity by default) -> LayerRenderState.setLocalTransform; not used here (keeps 1.21.5 compatibility).

Element coordinates must be within [-16, 32] (CuboidModelElement$Deserializer.getPosition: float -16.0f / 32.0f checks); every part fits, i.e. a part may reach at most 1.5 blocks from its joint. Flipped UVs (u1>u2, used to share the left limb texture with the right limb) are fine: FaceBakery.computeMaterialTransparency uses Math.min/max of the UVs.

Culling: item pipelines (26.3 RenderPipelines.ITEM_CUTOUT/ITEM_TRANSLUCENT never call withCull(false); 1.21.x itemEntityTranslucentCull) keep back-face culling, so the inside of the head is invisible. Inner head faces that would point at the camera are omitted from the model.
Texture atlas: item models resolve aooni:item/* from the item atlas (1.21.11+ atlases/items.json directory source 'item' over all namespaces; 1.21.5 block atlas also includes 'item/').

Display entities default to item_display:"none". Players without this resource pack see the magenta/black missing-model cube for aooni:* item models; use server.properties require-resource-pack=true or keep a block_display fallback.
